sections.Profile:
The "Miss Cue T" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game featuring six flippers, eleven passive bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Pool (Billiards), Sports, Original Theme
